prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool to make exactly 2 separate images from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. Do not run shell commands or write files. When done, reply with the absolute path of each generated image file, one per line, nothing else.

SPEC:
Full-screen 16:9 gameplay screenshot mockup of a NEW in-game combat HUD for the dark-fantasy East Asian action RPG "Pax RPG" (world of Yuruma). The HUD must look like it belongs to the SAME UI kit as the attached inventory screen: deep black-red lacquer panels, thin double borders of antique copper-gold with small diamond studs in the corners, tiny red sakura blossom clusters and red tassels on corners, faint seigaiha wave pattern inside panels, gold four-point star dividers, round medallion badges with gold rim, crimson glow on active elements, red moon accents. Do NOT use baroque carved roses or heavy ornate frames - keep the frames slim, elegant and readable like the inventory.

Background: third-person view of the heroine (white long hair, red coat) holding a katana in a dusk Japanese-style goblin city plaza, a goblin enemy in front of her, cinematic but slightly darkened so the HUD reads.

HUD layout (clean, minimal, plenty of empty screen in the centre):
- Bottom-left: round portrait medallion of the heroine in a slim gold ring with sakura cluster, small diamond level badge; to the right her name plaque, a long slim HEALTH bar (crimson fill with lighter recent-damage trail), under it a thinner CONCENTRATION bar that fills from the centre outward (amber-gold), and a hairline experience line.
- Bottom-centre: a row of 6 skill slots styled like the inventory equipment cells (square, dark lacquer, thin gold border, rarity glow on the active one, small key hint under each), with a larger round DEATHBLOW medallion in the middle with a crimson progress ring, and a healing flask slot at the end with charge pips.
- Top-left: small quest plaque (dark panel, gold header divider with a sakura medallion), two short quest lines.
- Top-right: round minimap in a slim gold ring with a compass strip above it; gold coin counter plaque under it.
- Top-centre: a long BOSS health bar frame in the same slim style with a small crest medallion in the middle and the boss name plaque under it.
- Right edge: a slim vertical enemy panel: small portrait medallion and two thin vertical bars (health crimson, concentration gold).
Text in the mockup should be short and in English (e.g. "TIAN LONG", "Lv 12", "Orc Warlord"), clean thin serif font in warm ivory. Sharp, high resolution, consistent lighting, professional AAA game UI.
Input images: Image 1: reference for style, shapes and composition; Image 2: reference for style, shapes and composition; Image 3: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
